question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
WITH ent_1st AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID AS ent_style_1
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    WHERE StyleStrength = 3
),
ent_2nd AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID AS ent_style_2
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    WHERE StyleStrength = 2
),
cust_1st AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID AS cust_style_1
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE PreferenceSeq = 1
),
cust_2nd AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID AS cust_style_2
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE PreferenceSeq = 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
FROM ent_1st e1
JOIN ent_2nd e2 ON e1.EntertainerID = e2.EntertainerID
JOIN cust_1st c1 ON 1=1
JOIN cust_2nd c2 ON c1.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
JOIN Entertainers e ON e.EntertainerID = e1.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = c1.CustomerID
WHERE (c1.cust_style_1 = e1.ent_style_1 AND c2.cust_style_2 = e2.ent_style_2)
   OR (c1.cust_style_1 = e2.ent_style_2 AND c2.cust_style_2 = e1.ent_style_1)
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
